method: equal-species unshrunk fitted-slope differences with genus-cluster percentile bootstrap
scope: exploratory trait-associated standardized-slope contrasts; no causal or molecular mechanism claim
family_interval: Bonferroni nominal 1-0.05/9 percentile interval per contrast, with bootstrap approximation
uncertainty_scope: empirical resampling of fitted slopes by genus; no photo refits, no explicit phylogenetic covariance or within-fit variance resampling
scaling_limit: slopes are per each species primary climate SD; trait contrasts may reflect sampled climate-range differences as well as biological sensitivity; native SD medians provided
